cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?

mechanism: A takes charge of a leak repair while respecting B completed paperwork and using B clues to locate who can override the final payment block.
confusable: Unlike merely collecting signatures, A probes actual blocking and reversal power; authority depends on keeping a tired helper willing to reveal it.
comparison: A caretaker influence route over finance differs from formal deputy bank access and approval rights.
seedUse: Use D54-b signatures/finance/caretaker distinction with S02-b accommodating the helper workload.
